facts.fact: GACI, described as the authority competent to regulate and develop the telecommunications and IT sector, held a Tripoli workshop on data centres and cloud computing under the national communications strategy; no budget line is stated.

On 2026-02-15 GACI held a workshop 'within the national communications strategy' on regulating data centres and cloud computing, with officials stating the aim of drafting specific legislation and a guidance manual.

systems.owner: General Authority for Communications and Informatics (GACI)
